I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name with an extent of approximately 0.0054 Hectare, in the Advance Tracing No. Maha/PJP/2022/291 dated 16.11.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Godahena in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 521, Godahena of Pallegampaha Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Poojapitiya in Kandy District in Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot zAZ - Godahena Watta Colony - Extent : 0.0054 Hectare North: GodahenaWatta Colony claimed by K. G. Somawathi and Others and Footpath; East : Footpath and

GodahenaWatta Colony claimed by K. G. Somawathi and Others; South: GodahenaWatta Colony claimed by K. G. Somawathi and Others; West: GodahenaWatta Colony claimed by K. G. Somawathi and Others. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2021/WS/334.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,''Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.10th April, 2024.
